annotations.text:
Option A — Ring-led
The goal ring and the running session share one hero band; headline figures sit beside them, so the top of the page answers 'how is today going' in one glance. App share as a donut, work type as a split bar.
Tradeoff: the hero is tall — on a 13" window the log starts lower.

Option B — Data-first grid
Everything is a chart: KPI cards with 7-day sparklines, an hour-by-hour rhythm bar chart, app share bars, a work-type donut. Running apps collapse to chips under the title so there is no right rail.
Tradeoff: denser and more 'analytics'; the timeline narrative is gone.

Option C — Timeline-led
Closest to today's structure, refined: more air, the timeline as the hero with focus brackets and a hover chip, the stat band with context lines, live cards on the right.
Tradeoff: fewest new visualisations; it leans on the timeline doing the explaining.

Common to all three: your app's tokens exactly (ground/card/well surfaces, 7-colour palette by app rank, SF Rounded tabular numerals, 11pt tracked labels, 12pt radius, system accent — try the Accent tweak). Hover any row, block, bar or donut slice for its tooltip; bars and rings animate in. Dark shown; light uses the same tokens.
